description.zh:
返回结果显示的语言。取值：

- zh-CN：中文

- en-US（默认值）：英文
description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh-CN: Chinese
*   en-US (default): English

description.zh: 地址池的ID，地址池的唯一识别码。
description.en: The ID of the address pool. This ID uniquely identifies the address pool.

description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

description.zh: 传入的参数作为更新后的备注，传空值则删除备注。
description.en: The input parameter serves as the updated note; if an empty value is passed, the note will be deleted.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns update-cloud-gtm-address-pool-remark --accept-language en-US --client-token 1ae05db4-10e7-11ef-b126-00163e240000 --address-pool-id pool-895280232254420000 --remark test --region cn-hangzhou
